context.user-input: a post carrying one observation the author already had
any social feed written in a second language
filled by the Regente before drafting

instruction.user-input: hear this order, draft the post, then audit and reflect before concluding it

define-symbol.user-input: something the author noticed and can state in one sentence — the whole payload of the post
a method other people are expected to adopt — what an observation turns into when the writer inflates it
a claim the writer added that the author never made, arriving as a paragraph that reads well and holds nothing the author said
reading the draft as someone meeting the subject for the first time, with no access to the conversation that produced it
a phrase the whole point rests on, doing that work with no example beside it

note.user-input: the author writes to be read once, not to be followed

do-not.user-input: promote an observation to a framework because a framework is easier to structure

intention.user-input: the reader leaves holding one word or one distinction, and nothing to adopt

section.needs: the observation, in one sentence, as the author stated it and not as it could be generalised
the concrete annoyance that produced it — what went wrong, how often, at whose cost
the register the opening sets, stated as what the author would actually say out loud

requirement.user-input: every claim in the draft traces to something the author said

format.user-input: running prose, no headers, no numbered framework, no call to action

limitation.user-input: the draft may be dense, and density is not the same as structure

constraint.user-input: the post stays unpitchable: no problem-solution shape, no scaling claim, no before and after

never.user-input: a paragraph enters the draft to fill a shape the author did not ask for

template.name: scientific-review
template.means: Apply scientific rigour: criticise the target, rework it with what the critique found, and validate the result against an external standard.

criticise.user-input: the draft, read cold — start to finish, once, with no prior context assumed

rework.user-input: the target itself, corrected by what the critique found

validate.user-input: a reader who works in this field, meets the subject here for the first time, and gets it without asking a question

find.user-input: every load-bearing phrase standing without an example beside it

warning.user-input: a load-bearing phrase makes the reader supply the example from personal experience, and a newer reader has none to supply

scrutinise.user-input: the closing lines, for a defence against a reading nobody offered

verify.user-input: terminology is consistent across the draft — the same thing named the same way, capitalised the same way, every time

avoid.user-input: idiom carried over from the first language of the author, and words that only exist in that language

problem.user-input: a shape an investor can lift: a bottleneck being fixed, a thing that scales, a state before and a state after

note.user-input: the audit reports; it does not rewrite

template.name: loop
template.means: Iterate on one target until a stated stop condition holds, deepening the detail on every pass instead of restating it. Each pass is checked for realism against the stop condition before the next one opens.

iterate.user-input: each paragraph, against what the author actually stated

instruction.user-input: one more import named and cut, going finer than the pass before — a whole thesis first, then a clause, then a single adjective doing the same work

condition.user-input: every paragraph traces to the author, and no paragraph needs a claim the author did not make in order to hold together

realistic.user-input: each pass against the stop condition, before opening the next one

distinguish.user-input: what the writer added and then read back as if it had been stated

warning.user-input: if a paragraph collapses once an unstated claim is removed, that claim was imported and the paragraph was built on it

template.name: reinforce
template.means: There is a must-follow rule. Raise its precedence and state why it holds, so it survives a long context.

mandatory.user-input: a correction from the author is authoritative and settles it — reread the chain before defending the sentence

reason.user-input: the writer is the one who lost the thread, and defending the sentence spends the turn that should have fixed it

constraint.user-input: an import is cut, never softened into a hedge that keeps it in the draft

template.name: track
template.means: Explain where a detail came from across a long context: where it entered, what changed it, where it stands now. For the small things a human lets slip.

context.user-input: this post, and the next one the author writes on the same subject

derive-from.user-input: each import found, and which paragraph carried it

elaborate.user-input: the chain: where it entered, what changed it, where it stands now

learn.user-input: the imports found here — they arrive the same way next time, as the paragraph that reads best

where.user-input: the last version the author corrected, never the last version the writer preferred

finally.user-input: on the open question, with the observation stated once and nothing after it

do-not.user-input: close with a call to action, a summary of what was just said, or a defence that no system is being sold

warning.user-input: a pre-emptive defence tells the reader there was something to suspect

confirmation.user-input: the draft against the author, before it is called finished

ready.user-input: the post ships as prose the author can paste, and not as a document
